commands.name: start
commands.description:
Starts a local HTTP server exposing endpoints for ETL/data transformation tasks. Useful for integrating with Power Query or other local ETL tools. 

Available endpoints:
  POST /ComputePrimaryKey — Accepts a JSON body with 'entity' and 'alternateKeys' to return a deterministic GUID primary key. 
    The 'alternateKeys' are a set of attributes that together uniquely identify a record and never change for its lifetime.

options.description: Optional. Port to run the server on (default: 50505) [default: 50505]

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploys a Dataverse package using Package Deployer. Accepts a NuGet package name, a local .pdpkg.zip file, or a package DLL.

options.name: --version
options.description: NuGet package version to install. Defaults to 'latest'. Only used with NuGet packages. [default: latest]

options.name: --deployable-package
options.description: Deployable package file name inside the NuGet package. Use when the package contains multiple .pdpkg files.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory where the downloaded and extracted files should be written. Defaults to a temporary directory.

options.name: --download-only
options.description: Download and extract the deployable package without invoking Package Deployer. Only used with NuGet packages.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Dataverse connection string used by the managed Package Deployer host. If omitted, txc checks DATAVERSE_CONNECTION_STRING and TXC_DATAVERSE_CONNECTION_STRING.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Dataverse environment URL used for PAC-style interactive sign-in when no connection string is provided.

options.name: --device-code
options.description: Use Microsoft Entra device code flow instead of opening a browser for interactive sign-in.

options.name: --settings
options.description: Runtime settings string passed to Package Deployer.

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Optional Package Deployer log file path.

options.name: --log-console
options.description: Enable Package Deployer console logging.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose Package Deployer logging.

arguments.name: PACKAGE
arguments.description: NuGet package name, or path to a local .pdpkg.zip / package DLL

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Provides a summary of repository structure, build system, project types, components, and how they are organized for development and deployment. Use this tool whenever the user asks about organizing or understanding the workspace. This includes details about the monorepo layout, use of .NET project and solution files, supported project types (such as Dataverse solutions, plugins, packages, Power Apps components, and custom code apps), and how projects are managed and built using MSBuild. The summary also explains how solution and package projects reference and compose other components for deployment, offering flexibility in organizing code for various scenarios.
